_status: Learner guide, Try it 1.2.1 and its answers (19 October 2026). Item wording follows the deck slide.

items.text: A former contractor's account still active three months later
items.why: Access rights must end when the contract ends (the access control family, 5.15 to 5.18).

items.text: A clerk opened a fake invoice; no one had trained staff to spot one
The server room key hangs by the door; no one logs who takes it
items.why: Physical security of the server room.

items.text: The portal's login page did not encrypt passwords in transit
No one knew which systems held citizen ID numbers
items.why: Inventory of information and other associated assets (5.9).
